description: DEP-05 §When a quorum_expired dispute ends: a QuorumBegin after the dispute's fork point (last_valid_sequence) ends it unless its confiscation already confirmed; a quorum_expired DisputeEnter is armed on only while its ground stands (anchor past the governing expiry, no re-establishment since). Judged from the ledger, never the chain tip. Under strict-lottery-v8 (ruleset, judged at the dispute's fork point; ruled 2026-11-15 as an amendment to REVIEW 11) a re-establishment ends it only once its spend of the vault confirmed (rotation_spend_confirmed): a recorded QuorumBegin that is still unspent leaves the dispute standing, and armed on, and the race goes on. A case without a ruleset is read under one before v8. latest_quorum_begin_sequence is the LEDGER's latest QuorumBegin, wherever it lies: an implementation that holds only a recent window of a ledger in memory (history_window_from, the first sequence it holds) must not read it from that window (signet soak 2026-11-22: deposits-rust ref4 on ledger 0aeebcc5 read none from its 50 000-update window and its un-armed DisputeEnter stood for good). fork_reuse: DEP-05 "A member MUST NOT let a live dispute on an earlier ground stand in for it" and DEP-06 "Where a yield is valid". Each case is one fork of ours on a quorum_expired DisputeEnter at fork_last_valid_sequence (armed or not, never yielded or acquired), the base's latest QuorumBegin, the ruleset at the fork point and whether a re-establishment after the fork point has its rotation spend confirmed, and a new dispute of ours on the same ledger at new_last_valid_sequence (punitive or an expiry); reuse says whether that new dispute is carried by the existing fork (true) or forks afresh (false). A fork whose ground is answered (ended, ignoring confiscation) stands in for nothing; one whose ground stands carries a later expiry dispute, and a punitive one only if it armed (an un-armed expiry DisputeEnter acts on no proof: signet 2026-11-20, ref7 on 5effb9e8).

ended.name: re-established, but the confiscation confirmed first
the QuorumBegin at the fork point is the one the dispute is about
soak ledger A: disputed at 72257 (expiry 4373), re-established at 73657, expired again
v8: re-established, recorded but unspent: the dispute stands (regtest 2026-11-15: the reference yielded here while its own confiscation sat in the mempool)
v8: re-established, its rotation spend confirmed: ended
v8: the confiscation confirmed first: not ended
before v8: re-established, recorded but unspent: ended (the reading the frozen rulesets keep)

signet 0aeebcc5 (2026-11-22): fork at 359090, re-established at 359228 and rotated to 436154 (each spend confirmed), that quorum expired at 12209; the base tip 492248, a 50 000-update window from 442249 holds no QuorumBegin: ended

arm.name: re-established since: the soak's stale anchor
a fresh dispute on the later expiry
v8: re-established but unspent: still armed on
v8: re-established and spent: not armed on

fork_reuse.name: no re-establishment: an expiry dispute reuses its fork (no new fork per watch pass)
no re-establishment: a punitive dispute is not absorbed by an un-armed expiry fork (signet 2026-11-20, ref7 on 5effb9e8)
no re-establishment: an armed expiry fork carries a punitive dispute
signet 0aeebcc5 (2026-11-22): re-established (spend confirmed) and expired again: the new expiry's dispute forks afresh
signet 0aeebcc5 shape, a punitive dispute: forks afresh
signet 0aeebcc5 shape, the old fork armed: answered all the same, forks afresh
v8: re-established but unspent: the race goes on, the fork still carries an expiry dispute
before v8: re-established, recorded but unspent: answered, forks afresh
